rationale: The primary repository (API engine, workers, scraper) at root LICENSE is GNU Affero General Public License v3 or later (AGPL-3.0-or-later), a strong copyleft license. This creates a network-copyleft obligation for any service offering derived from the main Firecrawl engine code. The SDK client libraries (js-sdk, python-sdk, ruby-sdk, elixir-sdk) are independently MIT-licensed, which is permissive, but the core scraping/crawling engine that Veridian would integrate is AGPL. Classification: BLOCK for the primary engine component; if only using an MIT SDK as a client to the hosted Firecrawl API service, the AGPL does not apply because no conveying or modification of AGPL code occurs. Important discrepancies noted: apps/api/package.json declares 'ISC' while the root LICENSE is AGPL-3.0 — the LICENSE file controls; apps/python-sdk/setup.py erroneously declares GPLv3 while pyproject.toml and LICENSE file are MIT — the LICENSE file and pyproject.toml govern (MIT).
